out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: Documentation on exhaust hood t it is past due for servicing.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. Have the exhaust hood serviced as soon as possible and prior to the follow-up inspection.

violations.title: Plumbing System, Design/Install per Law
violations.observation: The plumbing system serving this food service facility has not been designed, constructed, and installed according to the Plumbing Code. No grease trap is installed at this establishment.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be designed, constructed, and installed according to Law. NOTE: PIC advised grease trap installation is in progress.
